evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet RPC encryption behavior in src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp alongside wallet tests and documentation.
rationale: Deprecating post-creation wallet encryption addresses multiple severe fund-safety and backup hazards. As noted in the PR description, encrypting an existing wallet generates new keys that 'may result in loss of funds' if restored from pre-encryption backups, leaves unpurged plaintext key remnants on disk, and silently alters descriptor spending conditions (#26607).
